description: Concentrations of antibiotic resistance genes in wastewater and receiving waters following water treatment in SW England, June-October, 2015 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Information Data Centre. Prevalence of quinolone qnrS resistance gene in the aquatic environment from the Avon river catchment area receiving treated wastewater from 5 wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs), serving 1.5 million people and accounting for 75% of inhabitants living in the catchment area in the South West of England. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Information Data Centre. Its tags are Environmental Monitoring Facilities, Human Health and Safety. It offers 2 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
